clues.text: After Nebuzaradan burned the temple and broke down Jerusalem's walls, he carried the remaining people into this.
Jeremiah sent word to Babylon that this would be lengthy, so they should build houses and plant gardens.
As the people watched, Ezekiel brought out his bags for this by day and dug through a wall at evening.
Matthew counts fourteen generations from David to this time, and fourteen more from it to the Christ.
In Nehemiah's day, the assembly that returned from this made booths and lived in them with great rejoicing.
Mordecai the Benjamite, living in Susa, had been carried into this from Jerusalem along with King Jeconiah.
Amaziah, priest of Bethel, reported that Amos said Israel would surely go into this, away from their homeland.
